titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Ram, the Shut Gate and the Burning Bush (ch. 96, part 2 of 2)
part: ch. 96, part 2 of 2 — The Ram, the Shut Gate and the Burning Bush
about: The Council's reading of chapter 96 continues: the ram sent down in place of Isaac (Genesis 22) is Christ's flesh given for his divinity, and from it the argument turns to Adam and Eve and Mary the new Eve, who bore the Lord without corruption. Ezekiel's shut eastern gate (Ezekiel 44:1-2) and Moses' bush that burned without being consumed (Exodus 3:2) are read as figures of her.

sentences.t: ዓዲ ፡ ሶበ ፡ አዕረጎ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ለይስሐቅ ፡ ወልዲ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ቀርሜሌዎስ ፡ አውረደ ፡ እምሰማያት ፡ ቤዛ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ በግዐ ፡ ወይስሐቅሰ ፡ ኢተጠብሐ ፡ አላ ፡ ተጠብሐ ፡ በግዕ ፡ ዘወረደ ፡ እምሰማያት ፤
sentences.l: Again when he-brought-him-up Abraham Isaac his-son onto mountain-of Qarmelewos(?), he-brought-down from-heavens ransom-of Isaac a-ram; and-Isaac-indeed not-was-slaughtered but was-slaughtered a-ram which-came-down from-heavens;
sentences.i: Again, when Abraham brought Isaac his son up onto Mount Qarmelewos (?), God brought down from heaven a ram as Isaac's ransom. Isaac himself was not slaughtered; the ram that came down from heaven was slaughtered instead;
sentences.n: The story of Genesis 22 (the binding of Isaac), read as a figure of Christ. ዓዲ 'again, moreover'. ሶበ 'when'. አዕረጎ is the 3ms perfect of አዕረገ 'bring up' (causative of ዐርገ 'go up') + -ኦ 'him' (so 'brought him up'); the object is then named by ለይስሐቅ (ለ- marking the object). ወልዲ 'his son' (-ዲ is Bezold's spelling of the 3ms suffix). ደብረ ቀርሜሌዎስ is a construct chain, 'mount of Qarmelewos'; CRUX: the name (ቀርሜሌዎስ, read qärmelewos) looks like Carmel, where Genesis 22:2 has Moriah, and I give it as written (?). አውረደ 'he brought down' (causative of ወረደ); the subject, God, is understood. ቤዛ ይስሐቅ 'ransom of Isaac' (construct); በግዐ is the accusative 'a ram'. ወይስሐቅሰ is ወ- + ይስሐቅ + -ሰ 'as for, indeed'. ኢተጠብሐ 'was not slaughtered': ኢ- 'not' + ተጠብሐ, a tä-stem (passive) perfect of ጠብሐ 'slaughter'. አላ 'but'. ዘወረደ is ዘ- 'which' + ወረደ 'came down'.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ይተረጐም ፡ በእግዚኣብሔር ፡ አብ ፡ ወይስሐቅኒ ፡ ይተረጐም ፡ አምሳሊሁ ፡ ለክርስቶስ ፡ ወልድ ፤
sentences.l: for Abraham he-is-interpreted by-God the-Father, and-Isaac-also he-is-interpreted likeness-his of-Christ the-Son;
sentences.i: For Abraham is interpreted as God the Father, and Isaac, too, is interpreted as the likeness of Christ the Son;
sentences.n: The typology stated. እስመ 'for, because'. ይተረጐም is the 3ms imperfect of the four-letter verb ተርጐመ 'interpret, translate', here passive 'be interpreted, be explained'; በእግዚኣብሔር አብ is በ- 'by, in terms of' + God + አብ 'Father', so 'is read as God the Father' (the sense of በ- here is my reading). ወይስሐቅኒ is ወ- + ይስሐቅ + -ኒ 'also'. አምሳሊሁ is አምሳል 'likeness' (suffix-stem አምሳሊ-) + -ሁ 'his'; ለክርስቶስ ወልድ names the owner after the anticipating suffix, a pattern that recurs, so 'the likeness of Christ the Son'.

sentences.t: ወአመ ፡ ይወርድ ፡ እምሰማያት ፡ ለመድኀኒተ ፡ አዳም ፡ ወደቂቁ ፡ ኢተጠብሐ ፡ መለኮት ፡ ዘወረደ ፡ እምሰማያት ፡ አላ ፡ ተጠብሐት ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ እንተ ፡ ለብሰ ፡ በእንቲአነ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ምድራዊት ፡ እንተ ፡ ለብሰ ፡ እማርያም ፤
sentences.l: And-when he-comes-down from-heavens for-salvation-of Adam and-children-his, not-was-slaughtered the-divinity which-came-down from-heavens, but was-slaughtered flesh-his which he-put-on for-us, she, earthly(f.) which he-put-on from-Mary;
sentences.i: And when he came down from heaven to save Adam and his children, it was not the divinity that came down from heaven that was slaughtered; his flesh was slaughtered, the flesh he put on for our sake, that earthly flesh which he put on from Mary;
sentences.n: ወአመ 'and when, at the time that'; ይወርድ is a 3ms imperfect of ወረደ 'come down', here with past sense after አመ. ለመድኀኒተ is ለ- 'for' + መድኀኒት 'salvation, saving' (construct form -ተ before አዳም), 'for the salvation of Adam and his children' (ወደቂቁ 'and his children', ደቂቅ + -ሁ). ኢተጠብሐ 'was not slaughtered' (tä-stem passive, as in the last unit), with መለኮት 'divinity' as subject; ዘወረደ 'which came down'. ተጠብሐት is the 3fs form ('she was slaughtered'), agreeing with feminine ሥጋ 'flesh' + -ሁ 'his'. እንተ is the feminine relative 'which'; ለብሰ 'he put on' (3ms perfect of ለብሰ 'wear, clothe oneself'). በእንቲአነ 'for our sake' (በእንተ + -ነ 'us'). ይእቲ 'she, that (f.)' (resuming ሥጋ), ምድራዊት 'earthly' (feminine of ምድራዊ). እማርያም is እም- 'from' + ማርያም 'Mary'.

sentences.t: ትሌብዉኑ ፡ ወትጤይቁ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ አርአያ ፡ ወአምሳለ ፡ ለምድራዊ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ ወልደ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ዘኮነ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ለፈቃደ ፡ አቡሁ ፤
sentences.l: Do-you-understand-(question) and-you-examine this example and-likeness of-earthly Isaac son-of Abraham, who-became offering for-will-of his-father;
sentences.i: Do you grasp and examine this pattern and likeness of the earthly Isaac, the son of Abraham, who became an offering for his father's will?
sentences.n: ትሌብዉኑ is the 2mp imperfect of ለበወ 'understand, perceive' (from ልብ 'heart, mind') + the question enclitic -ኑ; the verb is a guess at the root, so 'grasp' is approximate (?). ወትጤይቁ 'and you examine' (2mp imperfect of ጠየቀ 'inquire, examine'). ዘንተ 'this' (accusative); አርአያ 'example, form' and አምሳለ 'likeness' are accusative nouns. ለምድራዊ ይስሐቅ: ለ- here shows the owner, 'of the earthly Isaac'. ወልደ አብርሃም is a construct chain 'son of Abraham'. ዘኮነ 'who became'; መሥዋዕተ 'an offering, sacrifice' (accusative predicate). ለፈቃደ አቡሁ is ለ- 'for' + ፈቃደ (construct of ፈቃድ 'will') + አቡሁ 'his father' (አብ + -ሁ, with the vowel -u- of the linking form).

sentences.t: ኮነ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ቤዛሁ ፡ በግዕ ፡ ሰማያዊ ፡ ወተቤዘወ ፡ ወልደ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ወለዘሰ ፡ ወረደ ፡ ወልደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ኮነ ፡ ቤዛሁ ፡ ለመለኮት ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ ለምድራዊ ፡ ወሞተ ፡ በሥጋሁ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ኢየሐምም ፡ መለኮቱ ፡ ወተውላጠ ፡ ኮነ ፤
sentences.l: It-was to-him his-ransom a-ram heavenly, and-was-ransomed the-son-of Abraham; and-as-for-him-who he-came-down, the-son-of God, it-was his-ransom for-the-divinity his-flesh, of-the-earthly; and-he-died in-flesh-his while not-suffers divinity-his, and-an-exchange(?) it-was;
sentences.i: A heavenly ram became his ransom, and the son of Abraham was ransomed. But for the one who came down, the Son of God, it was his earthly flesh that became the ransom for the divinity. He died in his flesh while his divinity did not suffer, and an exchange (?) came about;
sentences.n: ኮነ ሎቱ ቤዛሁ በግዕ 'there was for him his ransom, a ram'; ሎቱ is 'to him'. ተቤዘወ 'was ransomed' (tä-stem passive of ቤዘወ 'ransom'). ወለዘሰ is ወ- + ለ- + ዘ- 'he who' + -ሰ 'as for'; ወረደ 'came down'; ወልደ እግዚኣብሔር 'Son of God' (construct). ኮነ ቤዛሁ ለመለኮት ሥጋሁ ለምድራዊ: 'his flesh, the earthly, was ransom for the divinity', the owners named by ለ- after the anticipating suffixes. ሞተ 'he died'; እንዘ 'while' + the 3ms imperfect ኢየሐምም 'does not suffer' (ሐመመ 'suffer'); መለኮቱ 'his divinity'. CRUX: ወተውላጠ ኮነ: I read ተውላጠ as an accusative noun 'exchange, substitution' with ኮነ 'it became' (?); the alternative is a passive verb 'was changed', but the order and the -ጠ fit the noun.

sentences.t: መዋቲት ፡ ኮነት ፡ ሕይወተ ፡ በትንሣኤሃ ፡ ምስለ ፡ መለኮት ።
sentences.l: Mortal she-became life by-her-resurrection with divinity.
sentences.i: What was mortal became life, through its resurrection together with the divinity.
sentences.n: መዋቲት is the feminine of መዋቲ 'mortal, subject to death', agreeing with ሥጋ 'flesh' of the last unit; ኮነት is the 3fs perfect 'she became', and ሕይወተ is the accusative 'life' as predicate. በትንሣኤሃ is በ- 'by' + ትንሣኤ 'resurrection' + -ሃ 'her' (the flesh's). ምስለ 'with' + መለኮት 'divinity'.

sentences.t: ወገሃደ ፡ ተዐውቀ ፡ ዕበይነ ፡ ለሰብእ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘቤዘወነ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: And-openly it-was-known greatness-our, of-man, concerning him-who-ransomed-us, Christ son-of God;
sentences.i: And openly our greatness, that of mankind, has been made known on account of him who ransomed us, Christ, the Son of God;
sentences.n: ወገሃደ 'and openly, plainly'. ተዐውቀ is the 3ms tä-stem passive 'it was made known'. ዕበይነ is ዕበይ 'greatness' + -ነ 'our', the subject; ለሰብእ 'of man' names the owner (ለ-). በእንተ 'concerning, because of' (here 'on account of'). ዘቤዘወነ is ዘ- 'he who' + ቤዘወ 'ransomed' + -ነ 'us'. ክርስቶስ ወልደ እግዚኣብሔር 'Christ, Son of God' in apposition.

sentences.t: ወፈድፋደ ፡ ናክብራ ፡ በምድርኒ ፡ ወበሰማይኒ ፡ ለዛቲ ፡ እግዝእትነ ፡ ወላዲተ ፡ አምላክ ፡ ማርያም ፡ ድንግል ፡ ወስምዑ ፡ ዘኒ ፡ ፍካሬ ፡ ቀዳማዊ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘውእቱ ፡ አቡነ ፡ አዳም ፤
sentences.l: And-especially let-us-glorify-her on-earth-also and-in-heaven-also, this lady-our, bearer-of God, Mary the-virgin; and-hear also(?) interpretation-of first man who he our-father Adam;
sentences.i: And above all let us glorify her, on earth and in heaven alike, this our lady, the mother of God, the virgin Mary. And hear, too, the interpretation concerning the first man, who is our father Adam;
sentences.n: ፈድፋደ 'especially, above all'. ናክብራ is 1cp imperfect/jussive of አክበረ 'honour, glorify' (causative) + -ኣ 'her'; whether it is 'we glorify' or 'let us glorify' the form cannot say, and I read it as a jussive. በምድርኒ and ወበሰማይኒ are በ- 'in' + noun + -ኒ 'also', 'on earth and in heaven both'. ለዛቲ እግዝእትነ names the object after -ኣ: ለዛቲ 'this (f.)', እግዝእት 'lady' + -ነ 'our'. ወላዲተ አምላክ is a construct chain, 'bearer of God' (ወላዲት, feminine participle: the Theotokos title). ወስምዑ 'and hear!' (2mp imperative). ዘኒ I take as an adverb 'also, likewise' (?). ፍካሬ ቀዳማዊ ብእሲ 'interpretation of the first man'; ዘውእቱ 'who is'. For the Adam/Christ pairing compare 1 Corinthians 15:45 and Romans 5:14; the Eve/Mary pairing is not scriptural but a later Christian reading.

sentences.t: ዘእንበለ ፡ ትድምርት ፡ ወሩካቤ ፡ እምዐፅመ ፡ ገቦሁ ፡ ተፈጥረት ፡ ሔዋን ፡ እምብእሲ ፡ ወይእቲ ፡ ኮነቶ ፡ ቢጾ ፤
sentences.l: Without union and-intercourse, from-bone-of his-side she-was-created Eve from-man, and-she she-was-to-him his-companion;
sentences.i: Without union or intercourse, Eve was created out of the man, from the bone of his side, and she became his companion;
sentences.n: Genesis 2:21-22, Eve from Adam's rib. ዘእንበለ 'without'; ትድምርት 'union, joining' and ሩካቤ 'meeting, intercourse' (from ረከበ 'find, meet'; the sense is clear from the context). እምዐፅመ ገቦሁ is እም- 'from' + ዐፅም 'bone' (construct ዐፅመ) + ገቦ 'side' + -ሁ 'his'. ተፈጥረት is the 3fs tä-stem passive 'she was created' (ፈጠረ 'create'). እምብእሲ 'from the man'. ኮነቶ is the 3fs perfect ኮነት 'she became' + -ኦ 'to him'; ቢጾ is ቢጽ 'companion, fellow' + -ሁ 'his'.

sentences.t: ወሰሚዓ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ሕብል ፡ እምዕድዉ ፡ ለአዳም ፡ ኮነቶ ፡ ቀታሊተ ፡ በአዕልዎ ፡ ትእዛዝ ፤
sentences.l: And-having-heard word-of cord(?) from-enemy(?) of-Adam, she-became-to-him killer by-transgressing commandment;
sentences.i: And having heard a word of snare (?) from the enemy (?) of Adam, she became his killer, by transgressing the commandment;
sentences.n: Genesis 3, the fall. ወሰሚዓ is the converb (gerund, 3fs) 'having heard' of ሰምዐ 'hear'. CRUX: ቃለ ሕብል is a construct chain 'word of ሕብል'; ሕብል means 'cord, rope', so I take it as a 'snare-word', a deceiving word, which the serpent spoke (?). CRUX: እምዕድዉ ለአዳም 'from the enemy of Adam': I read ዕድዉ as 'enemy, adversary', as in ch. 92-93 (ዕድዉ ለሰብእ, said of Satan), where it was also a guess from context (?); the serpent is meant, and ለ- is the genitive link after the noun (compare ዕበይነ ለሰብእ in an earlier unit). The other reading, ዕድው 'man' (ch. 35, 'from the man'), fits neither ለአዳም nor the sense. ኮነቶ is the 3fs perfect ኮነት + -ኦ 'to him' (to Adam): 'she became to him a killer'; ቀታሊተ is the feminine of ቀታሊ 'killer', accusative as predicate. በአዕልዎ is በ- 'by' + አዕልዎ, taken as the infinitive of a causative verb አዕለወ from the root of ዕልወት 'transgression' (used a few units on), 'by transgressing' (?); ትእዛዝ 'commandment' is its object.

sentences.t: ወበምሕረቱ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ አብ ፡ ፈጠራ ፡ ለባሕርይ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ከርሡ ፡ ለአዳም ፤
sentences.l: And-by-mercy-his, God the-Father, he-created-her, the-pearl, within womb-his of-Adam;
sentences.i: And by the mercy of God the Father, he created her, the pearl, within the womb of Adam;
sentences.n: ወበምሕረቱ 'and by his mercy' (በ- + ምሕረት + -ሁ), with እግዚኣብሔር አብ 'God the Father' naming the owner after the suffix. ፈጠራ is the 3ms perfect of ፈጠረ 'create' + -ኣ 'her'; ለባሕርይ names the object. ባሕርይ is 'pearl' (also 'nature, essence'): I give the house reading 'the pearl', the figure for Mary carried in Adam's womb down the generations (ch. 68: 'created in the womb of Adam like a pearl-stone'; ch. 25-26, 95), here with the feminine -ኣ of ፈጠራ resuming it. በውስተ 'within'; ከርሡ is ከርሥ 'womb, belly' + -ሁ 'his' ('womb' as in ch. 68), and ለአዳም names the owner.

sentences.t: አንጺሖ ፡ ሥጋሃ ፡ ወቀዱሶ ፡ አኅደራ ፡ ላዕሌሃ ፡ ለመድኀኒቱ ፤
sentences.l: Having-purified flesh-her and-having-sanctified (it), he-made-it-dwell(?) upon-her for-his-salvation;
sentences.i: Having purified her flesh and sanctified it, he made it (?) dwell upon her, for his salvation;
sentences.n: አንጺሖ and ወቀዱሶ are converbs (gerunds, 'having done'), from አንጽሐ 'purify' (causative) and ቀደሰ 'sanctify'; ሥጋሃ 'her flesh' (-ሃ 'her'). አኅደራ is the 3ms perfect of አኅደረ 'make dwell, lodge' (causative of ኀደረ 'dwell') + -ኣ 'her, it'. CRUX: the antecedent of -ኣ is unclear; with ባሕርይ 'the pearl' (feminine) in unit 10 it may be the pearl, or else the Word or the divine nature set to dwell 'upon her'; I give 'it' (?). ላዕሌሃ 'upon her'. ለመድኀኒቱ is ለ- 'for' + መድኀኒት 'salvation' + -ሁ 'his'.

sentences.t: ተወልደት ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ጥልቀት ፡ እስመ ፡ ገብራ ፡ ለንጽሕት ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ርስሐት ፡ ወይእቲ ፡ ፈደየት ፡ ዕዳሁ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ትድምርት ፡ ወዘእንበለ ፡ ሩካቤ ፤
sentences.l: She-was-born without defect(?), for he-made-her pure, without impurity; and-she she-paid his-debt, without union and-without intercourse;
sentences.i: She was born without defect (?), for he had made her pure, without impurity; and she paid his debt, without union and without intercourse;
sentences.n: ተወልደት 'she was born' (3fs tä-stem passive of ወለደ 'bear'). CRUX: ጥልቀት is not in my aids; I take it as a word for a flaw or stain, parallel to ርስሐት 'impurity' (?). እስመ 'for'; ገብራ is the 3ms perfect of ገብረ 'make' + -ኣ 'her', and ለንጽሕት 'pure (f.)' marks what she was made. ፈደየት is the 3fs perfect of ፈደየ 'pay, repay'; ዕዳሁ is ዕዳ 'debt' + -ሁ 'his'; whose debt it is (Adam's, from the earlier units) is not stated (?). ወዘእንበለ 'and without', the ወ- repeating before the second item.

sentences.t: ወለደት ፡ በሥጋ ፡ ሰማያዊ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ወውእቱ ፡ ተወልደ ፡ እምኔሃ ፡ ወሐደሳ ፡ ለሕይወት ፡ በንጽሐ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ ወቀተሎ ፡ ለሞት ፡ በሥጋሁ ፡ ንጽሕት ፡ ወተንሥአ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ሙስና ፡ ወአንሥአነ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኢመዋቲት ፡ መንበረ ፡ መለኮት ፡ ወአዕረገነ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ወተወለጥነ ፡ ሕይወተ ፡ በሥጋነ ፡ መዋቲት ፡ ወረከብነ ፡ ሕይወተ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኢትመውት ፤
sentences.l: She-bore in-flesh a-heavenly king, and-he he-was-born from-her, and-he-renewed-it, life, by-purity-of flesh-his, and-he-killed-him, death, by-flesh-his pure, and-he-rose without corruption, and-he-raised-us with-him to the-deathless(?), throne-of divinity, and-he-brought-us-up to-him; and-we-were-changed life(?) in-flesh-our mortal, and-we-found life which not-it-dies;
sentences.i: She bore a heavenly king in the flesh, and he was born from her. He renewed life by the purity of his flesh, and killed death by his pure flesh; he rose without corruption and raised us with him to the deathless (?) throne of divinity, and brought us up to himself. We were changed into life (?) in our mortal flesh, and we found a life that does not die;
sentences.n: ወለደት 'she bore' (3fs perfect); ሰማያዊ ንጉሠ 'a heavenly king' (accusative). ወውእቱ ተወልደ 'and he was born' (tä-stem passive); እምኔሃ 'from her'. ወሐደሳ is the 3ms perfect of ሐደሰ 'renew' + -ኣ 'it', with ለሕይወት 'life' naming the object; በንጽሐ ሥጋሁ 'by the purity (construct) of his flesh'. ወቀተሎ is ቀተለ 'kill' + -ኦ 'him', with ለሞት 'death' as object. ተንሥአ 'he rose' (tä-stem); ዘእንበለ ሙስና 'without corruption'. ወአንሥአነ 'and he raised us' (causative አንሥአ + -ነ). ኀበ 'to, toward'; ኢመዋቲት is the negated feminine 'deathless', which agrees badly with masculine መንበር 'throne' (መንበረ መለኮት 'throne of divinity', construct), so I take them in apposition, 'to the deathless one, the throne...' (?). ወአዕረገነ 'and he brought us up' (causative of ዐርገ). ወተወለጥነ is the 1cp tä-stem passive of ወለጠ 'change, exchange', 'we were changed'; ሕይወተ 'life' (accusative) I take as what we were changed into (?), as the mortal 'became life' in unit 5; 'exchanged for life' is the alternative; በሥጋነ መዋቲት 'in our mortal flesh'. ወረከብነ 'and we found'. እንተ ኢትመውት is the feminine relative + the 3fs imperfect negated, 'which does not die' (ሕይወት is feminine).

sentences.t: በስሕታተ ፡ አዳም ፡ ተመንደብነ ፡ ወበትዕግሥተ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ተፈወስነ ፡ በዕልወተ ፡ ሔዋን ፡ ሞትነ ፡ ወተቀበርነ ፡ ወበንጽሓ ፡ ለማርያም ፡ ከበርነ ፡ ወተላዐልነ ፡ እስከ ፡ አርያም ፡ ተነበየ ፡ ካዕበ ፡ ሕዝቅኤል ፡ በእንተ ፡ ማርያም ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ርኢኩ ፡ ኆኅተ ፡ በምሥራቅ ፡ ኅቱም ፡ በዐቢይ ፡ መንክር ፡ ማኅተም ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘቦአ ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ዘእንበ ፡ ለ ፡ እግዚአ ፡ ኀያላን ፡ ቦአ ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ወወፅአ ፤
sentences.l: By-the-errors-of Adam we-were-afflicted(?), and-by-patience-of Christ we-were-healed; by-transgression-of Eve we-died and-we-were-buried, and-by-her-purity, of-Mary, we-were-honoured and-we-were-exalted up-to the-heights. He-prophesied again Ezekiel concerning Mary and-he-said: I-saw a-gate in-the-east, sealed, by-a-great wonderful seal, and-there-is-not who-entered in-it except the-Lord-of the-mighty; he-entered in-it and-he-went-out;
sentences.i: Through Adam's errors we were afflicted (?), and through Christ's patience we were healed; through Eve's transgression we died and were buried, and through Mary's purity we were honoured and lifted up to the heights. Ezekiel prophesied again about Mary, and said: 'I saw a gate in the east, sealed with a great and wondrous seal, and no one entered it except the Lord of the mighty; he entered it and went out';
sentences.n: The Adam/Christ and Eve/Mary contrasts, then Ezekiel 44:1-2 (the shut gate of the sanctuary). በስሕታተ 'by the errors (of)' (በ- + ስሕተት plural in construct). CRUX: ተመንደብነ is a tä-stem 1cp perfect of the four-letter verb መንደበ 'afflict' (?), like ተመንደብኪ in ch. 91 (part 1 has the Aʾ form አመንደብዎሙ). ተፈወስነ 'we were healed' (passive of ፈወሰ). በትዕግሥተ is በ- + ትዕግሥት 'patience' (construct). በዕልወተ ሔዋን 'by the transgression of Eve'. ሞትነ 'we died' (1cp perfect), ተቀበርነ 'we were buried' (passive). በንጽሓ ለማርያም is 'by her purity, that of Mary' (ንጽሕ + -ኣ, with ለ- naming the owner). ከበርነ 'we were honoured' (ከበረ 'be honoured, glorious'), ተላዐልነ 'we were exalted' (tä-stem of ላዐለ, from ላዕል 'high'; compare ch. 90); እስከ አርያም 'up to the height, heaven'. ተነበየ ካዕበ 'prophesied again'; ሕዝቅኤል Ezekiel. ርኢኩ 'I saw'; ኆኅተ 'a gate' (accusative); ኅቱም 'sealed' (a passive participle of ኀተመ 'seal', as ተኀትመት in unit 20; 'shut' is ዕጹት in unit 19); ማኅተም 'seal'; በዐቢይ መንክር 'by a great wondrous (one)'. ወአልቦ ዘቦአ 'and there is none who entered'. The text prints ዘእንበ ለ as two words, to be read ዘእንበለ 'except' (the last syllable cut off by the printed word-space). እግዚአ ኀያላን 'lord of the mighty' (construct; ኀያላን plural of ኀያል 'strong'). ቦአ ውስቴታ ወወፅአ 'he entered into it (ውስቴታ, 'in her') and went out'.

sentences.t: ዘኒ ፡ ፍካሬሁ ፡ ስምዑ ፤
sentences.l: Also(?) interpretation-its hear;
sentences.i: Hear its interpretation, too;
sentences.n: ዘኒ 'also, further' (?; ዘ- + -ኒ 'also', used as an adverb in this chapter). ፍካሬሁ 'its interpretation' (ፍካሬ + -ሁ). ስምዑ 'hear!' (2mp imperative of ሰምዐ).

sentences.t: ዘይቤ ፡ ርኢኩ ፡ ኆኅተ ፡ በአማን ፡ ኆኅተ ፡ አንቀጸ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ሙባኦሙ ፡ ለቅዱሳን ፡ ውስተ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ ሰማያት ፤
sentences.l: What-he-said, I-saw a-gate: in-truth a-gate, gate-of heaven, their-entering(?), of-the-saints, into kingdom-of heavens;
sentences.i: What he said, 'I saw a gate', means truly a gate: the gate of heaven, the entrance (?) of the saints into the kingdom of heaven;
sentences.n: ዘይቤ is ዘ- 'what, that which' + ይቤ 'he said'. በአማን 'in truth, truly'. ኆኅተ አንቀጸ ሰማይ 'a gate, the gate of heaven' (አንቀጽ 'gate' in construct before ሰማይ). ሙባኦሙ is a noun of place from ቦአ 'enter', 'entrance' (?), with -ሙ 'their'; ለቅዱሳን names the owners, 'of the saints'. ውስተ መንግሥተ ሰማያት 'into the kingdom (construct) of the heavens'.

sentences.t: ወበምሥራቅ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይብል ፡ በእንተ ፡ ንጽሐ ፡ ወአዳም ፡ ሥና ፤
sentences.l: And-in-the-east, when he-says, concerning purity, and pleasing(?) beauty(?);
sentences.i: And when he says 'in the east', he speaks of purity, and of pleasing beauty (?);
sentences.n: ወበምሥራቅ 'and in the east'; ሶበ ይብል 'when he says' (3ms imperfect of ብህለ 'say'). በእንተ 'concerning'; ንጽሐ is the accusative 'purity', as in part 1. CRUX: ወአዳም ሥና is hard. Earlier parts read አዳም as an adjective 'pleasing, comely' (?) (ወአዳም in ch. 25-26 and 35), so I take 'purity and pleasing beauty'; ሥና may be 'beauty' or 'goodness', or ሥን 'beauty' + -ኣ 'her' (ሥን-ኣ, as ቈጽል-ኣ below), 'her beauty' (?). The other reading, 'Adam' as the first man (the east recalling Eden, Genesis 2:8), would need a genitive the text does not show; the clause may be damaged (?).

sentences.t: ይብልዋ ፡ አንቀጸ ፡ አድኅኖ ፡ ወይብልዋ ፡ ምሥራቅ ፡ ዘይኔጽርዎ ፡ ቅዱሳን ፡ በፍሥሓ ፡ ወበሐሤት ፤
sentences.l: They-call-her gate-of salvation, and-they-call-her east, which-they-look-at-it the-saints with-joy and-with-gladness;
sentences.i: They call her the gate of salvation, and they call her the east, which the saints look toward with joy and gladness;
sentences.n: ይብልዋ is ይብሉ 'they say, call' (3mp imperfect of ብህለ) + -ዋ 'her'; it takes a second accusative, 'call her X'. አንቀጸ አድኅኖ 'gate (construct) of salvation' (አድኅኖ, the verbal noun of አድኅነ 'save'). ዘይኔጽርዎ is ዘ- 'which' + the 3mp imperfect of ነጸረ 'look at' + -ዎ 'it'; ቅዱሳን 'saints' is the subject. በፍሥሓ 'with joy', ወበሐሤት 'and with gladness'.

sentences.t: ወዕጹታ ፡ ዘይቤ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ንጽሐ ፡ ድንግልናሃ ፡ ወሥጋሃ ፤
sentences.l: And-her-being-shut, what-he-said, concerning purity-of her-virginity and-her-flesh;
sentences.i: And her being shut, which he mentioned, is about the purity of her virginity and of her flesh;
sentences.n: ወዕጹታ is ወ- + ዕጹት 'shut' (feminine) + -ኣ 'her', 'and her being shut'; ዘይቤ 'what he said'. በእንተ ንጽሐ ድንግልናሃ ወሥጋሃ 'concerning the purity (construct) of her virginity and her flesh'; ድንግልና 'virginity' + -ሃ 'her', ሥጋ 'flesh' + -ሃ.

sentences.t: ወበእንተ ፡ ዘይቤ ፡ በዐቢይ ፡ መንክር ፡ ማኅተም ፡ ዝኒ ፡ ያርኢ ፡ ገሃደ ፡ በእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ መንክር ፡ በመንፈስ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ተኀትመት ፤
sentences.l: And-concerning what-he-said, by-a-great wonderful seal, this-also it-shows openly: by-God, the-great, the-wonderful, by-Spirit Holy, she-was-sealed;
sentences.i: And as for what he said, 'with a great and wondrous seal', this too shows plainly that she was sealed by God, the great and wondrous one, by the Holy Spirit;
sentences.n: ወበእንተ ዘይቤ 'and concerning what he said'; በዐቢይ መንክር ማኅተም repeats Ezekiel's words (Ezekiel 44:1-2). ዝኒ is ዝ 'this' + -ኒ 'also'. ያርኢ is the 3ms imperfect of አርአየ 'show' (causative); ገሃደ 'plainly'. ተኀትመት is the 3fs tä-stem passive of ኀተመ 'seal', 'she was sealed' (the gate is Mary, feminine). በእግዚኣብሔር ዐቢይ መንክር በመንፈስ ቅዱስ: the agent is God, with 'great, wondrous' in apposition, then the Spirit; the alternative 'by the great wonder of God' is possible (?).

sentences.t: ወዘይቤሂ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘቦአ ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ እግዚአ ፡ ኀያላን ፡ ቦአ ፡ ወወፅአ ፡ ውእቱኬ ፡ ፈጣሬ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ ወምድር ፡ ፈጣሬ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ወሰብእ ፡ ወአጋእዝት ፡ እግዚአ ፡ ኀያላን ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ፍሬ ፡ መለኮት ፡ ዘለብሰ ፡ ሥጋነ ፡ እምኔሃ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ቦአ ፡ ወወፅአ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኀቤሃ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ሙስና ።
sentences.l: And-what-he-said-also, there-is-not who-entered in-it except the-Lord-of the-mighty, he-entered and-he-went-out: he-indeed, creator-of heavens and-earth, creator-of angels and-men and-lords, Lord-of the-mighty he, fruit-of divinity, who-put-on flesh-our from-her, Christ; he-entered and-he-went-out, which (f.) with-her, without corruption.
sentences.i: And what he said further, 'No one entered it except the Lord of the mighty; he entered and went out': that is he who created heaven and earth, creator of angels and men and lords. He is the Lord of the mighty, the fruit of the divinity, Christ, who put on our flesh from her. He entered and went out, by what was hers (?), without corruption.
sentences.n: ወዘይቤሂ 'and what he said too' (ዘ- + ይቤ + -ሂ 'too, also'). The quoted words repeat Ezekiel's words from the earlier unit. ውእቱኬ is ውእቱ 'he' + -ኬ 'indeed, then'. ፈጣሬ is the construct of ፈጣሪ 'creator': ፈጣሬ ሰማያት ወምድር 'creator of heavens and earth', ፈጣሬ መላእክት ወሰብእ ወአጋእዝት 'creator of angels and men and lords' (አጋእዝት is the plural of እግዚእ 'lord'). ፍሬ መለኮት 'fruit (construct) of divinity'. ዘለብሰ ሥጋነ እምኔሃ 'who put on our flesh from her'; ክርስቶስ in apposition. CRUX: እንተ ኀቤሃ is the feminine relative 'which' + ኀቤሃ 'with her, at her'; the antecedent is unstated, and I read 'by what was hers' (?), the gate being in effect her virginal body. ዘእንበለ ሙስና 'without corruption'.

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ተነበየ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ማርያም ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ርኢኩ ፡ ጳጦስ ፡ በደብረ ፡ ሲና ፡ እንተ ፡ ኢያውዐያ ፡ እሳት ፡ በላዒ ፤
sentences.l: And-again he-prophesied Moses concerning Mary and-he-said: I-saw a-bush on-mount-of Sinai which not-burns-it fire, consuming;
sentences.i: And Moses prophesied again about Mary, and said: 'I saw a bush on Mount Sinai that the consuming fire did not burn';
sentences.n: Exodus 3:2, the burning bush (also Deuteronomy 4:24, 'a consuming fire'). ወካዕበ 'and again'; ተነበየ 'he prophesied' (tä-stem). ጳጦስ 'bush' (a Greek loanword, batos); በደብረ ሲና 'on mount (construct) of Sinai'. ኢያውዐያ is ኢ- 'not' + the 3ms imperfect of አውዐየ 'burn, set alight' (causative of ውዕየ) + -ኣ 'it, her'; እንተ is the feminine relative, agreeing with ጳጦስ taken as feminine here. እሳት በላዒ 'fire, consuming' (በላዒ is the active participle of በልዐ 'eat, consume').

sentences.t: ወፍካሬሁ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ እሳት ፡ መለኮት ፡ ወልደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወዕፀ ፡ ጳጦስ ፡ ዘትነድድ ፡ ወቈጽላ ፡ ኢትውዒ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ማርያም ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-interpretation-its, of-this fire: divinity, the-Son-of God; and-tree-of bush which-burns, and-leaf-her not-it-burns: this she Mary.
sentences.i: And the interpretation of this fire is the divinity, the Son of God; and the tree of the bush that burns while its foliage is not consumed: this is Mary.
sentences.n: ወፍካሬሁ ለዝንቱ እሳት 'and the interpretation of this fire' (ለ- naming the owner after the suffix; ዝንቱ 'this (m.)'). መለኮት ወልደ እግዚኣብሔር 'the divinity, the Son of God'. ወዕፀ ጳጦስ 'and the tree (construct) of the bush'; ዘትነድድ is ዘ- 'which' + the 3fs imperfect of ነደደ 'burn' (intransitive); ወቈጽላ 'and its leaf, foliage' (ቈጽል + -ኣ), ኢትውዒ 'does not burn' (3fs imperfect of ውዕየ, negated). ዛቲ ይእቲ ማርያም 'this one is Mary' (ዛቲ 'this (f.)', ይእቲ 'she'). The final ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ is the printed closing ornament of the chapter.
